state.objective: Pass every obstacle without a collision.
state.timing_policy: One choice per obstacle; controller centers the jump apex on horizontal overlap. Local box physics, not Chrome physics.

action.instructions: Choose a maneuver to pass the obstacle. Prefer keep_running when it clears a standing dinosaur, duck when only standing is blocked, and a jump otherwise. Use jump_short only for one small cactus; use jump_full for larger obstacles. The controller handles launch timing using the supplied box geometry.
